Q6111.reason: A general littering ordinance is a content-neutral O'Brien regulation: park cleanliness is an important interest unrelated to the protest message, so the incidental burden on symbolic dumping is valid.

Q5735.reason: Under 28 U.S.C. § 1441 only a defendant may remove, so the plaintiff's notice was ineffective and the defendant's timely remand motion returns the entire case to state court.

Q5651.reason: Advertising a 1964 Thunderbird is an express warranty of description under UCC 2-313, and an as-is clause cannot disclaim that warranty under UCC 2-316.
